scope: Independent adjudication of Q02, Q10, Q12, Q13, Q17 for seed-iteration-02 only

grading_standard.correct: All requested material parts resolved correctly, with no material contradictory caveat.
grading_standard.partial: Requested omission or abstention without a material contradiction.
grading_standard.incorrect: Material contradiction, including an added contradictory caveat.

reader_a.reason: The requested setup is substantially correct, including the map, both mats, and the source of starting statistics. However, the answer omits the action token starting beside the Player Mat, which is part of the requested starting arrangement. The caveat about exact player-specific starting amounts is appropriate: no particular mats or amounts were requested.
reader_a.finding: Missing action-token starting position; no material contradiction.

reader_b.reason: Includes the same substantive setup and explicitly places the action token beside the Player Mat. Correctly assigns starting power/combat cards to the Faction Mat and popularity/coins/objectives to the Player Mat.

reader_a.reason: Correctly identifies oil for Upgrade and metal for Deploy, the legal cube/mech placements, permanent ability effect, and paying a completed action for coins and applicable recruit bonuses. Precise quantities and coin payouts depend on the Player Mat and upgrades; the caveat does not deny any universal quantity that the question requires. No particular Player Mat was supplied.

reader_b.reason: Resolves the requested resource types, placement restrictions, ability effects, and completed-action payment. It does not invent a universal numerical resource cost. A mat-specific quantity is not an additional mandatory answer to this generic question.

reader_a.reason: Correctly explains recruit placement, all four one-time bonuses, that the uncovered action section determines the ongoing bonus, player order, and the two-player rule. But its final claim that the exact bonus for each recruit location is mat-specific and unsupported is a material contradictory caveat: the frozen summary explicitly supplies the fixed action-to-bonus mapping (Upgrade power; Deploy coins; Build popularity; Enlist combat card). This is a finding even though the question does not separately require enumerating that mapping.
reader_a.finding: Contradictory unsupported/mat-specific claim about known ongoing recruit bonuses.

reader_b.reason: Correctly covers every requested part and gives the explicit ongoing-bonus mapping. Food cost and action announcements appear in the answer key but are not independent requested parts of this question, so their omission is not a finding.

reader_a.reason: Correctly states dial limits, card allowance, attacker-first abilities, simultaneous totals, dial-power payment without charging card values against the track, and attacker tie wins. It never states what happens to used combat cards: both players must discard them face-up. That is an omission in the requested spending/payment resolution, not a contrary ruling.
reader_a.finding: Missing used-card disposal/payment: discard used combat cards face-up.

reader_b.reason: Includes all requested combat spending and resolution rules, explicitly including both players discarding used cards face-up. Neither answer needs an additional unsolicited statement that combat can be initiated at zero popularity.

reader_a.reason: Gives own-turn timing before/after a complete action, all requirements being satisfied at reveal, both objective cards discarded to the deck bottom, and Saxony keeping and completing its second objective. The caveat that specific objectives depend on their cards is true and does not leave this generic timing/requirements question unresolved. No specific objective card was supplied or requested.

reader_b.reason: Correctly gives timing, current fulfillment of all requirements, discard destination, normal one-objective limit, and Saxony completing both. Discussion of Saxony combat-star limits is an extra answer-key fact outside this objective question.
